6. **Educate Yourself and Others**: Stay informed about the latest phishing techniques and share this knowledge with your peers and family to make cyber threats more challenging for others.

Remember, the best way to protect yourself is to be cautious and skeptical of any communication that seems out of the ordinary or too good to be true.
